title: Watermelon
summary: Determine if a watermelon of weight w can be divided into two parts, each weighing an even positive integer amount.
approach: Check if the weight is strictly greater than 2 and divisible by 2. Any even number greater than 2 can be split into two even positive integers (e.g., 2 and w - 2).
time: O(1) constant time parity check.
edge_cases: w = 2 is even but cannot be split into two positive even integers.

title: Palindrome Number
summary: Determine whether an integer reads the same forwards and backwards.
approach: Negative numbers cannot be palindromes. For non-negative integers, reverse the digits iteratively and compare the reversed value with the original number.
time: O(log10(n)) proportional to the number of decimal digits.
space: O(1) auxiliary space using scalar variables.
edge_cases: Negative numbers return false; numbers ending in 0 (other than 0 itself) cannot be palindromes.

title: Team
summary: Count how many problems will be implemented if at least two out of three team members are sure about the solution.
approach: Iterate through each problem, sum the three opinions, and increment the counter if the sum is 2 or greater.
time: O(n) where n is the number of problems.
edge_cases: All 0s (sum = 0) or all 1s (sum = 3).

title: Bit++
summary: Calculate the final value of variable X starting at 0 after executing a sequence of increment and decrement statements.
approach: For each statement, check if it contains '+' to increment X, otherwise decrement X.
time: O(n) where n is the number of statements.
edge_cases: Initial state X = 0.

title: Next Round
summary: Count how many participants advance to the next round by scoring at least as many points as the k-th place finisher and having a positive score.
approach: Find the k-th participant's score, then iterate through the scores and count participants whose score is >= k-th score and > 0.
time: O(n) where n is the number of participants.
space: O(n) or O(1) space to store or stream scores.
edge_cases: k-th place finisher has a score of 0 (no one with 0 points can advance).
